text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES'] <= df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']"],"features":["NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES","IN_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"The size bins count disjoint subsets of observed flow packets, so their total cannot exceed the total packet count; packets larger than 1514 bytes may be outside the bins."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] <= df['IN_PKTS']"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","IN_PKTS"],"rationale":"Retransmitted source-to-destination packets are a subset of the observed packets in that direction."},{"id":"R3","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] <= df['OUT_PKTS']"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"Retransmitted destination-to-source packets are a subset of the observed packets in that direction."},{"id":"R4","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] <= df['IN_BYTES']"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","IN_BYTES"],"rationale":"Bytes attributed to source-to-destination retransmissions are included among the observed bytes in that direction."},{"id":"R5","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] <= df['OUT_BYTES']"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","OUT_BYTES"],"rationale":"Bytes attributed to destination-to-source retransmissions are included among the observed bytes in that direction."}]}
